اعتصمت (form VIII)
# اِعْتَصَمْتُ (iʕtaṣamtu) /iʕ.ta.sˤam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# اِعْتَصَمْتَ (iʕtaṣamta) /iʕ.ta.sˤam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# اِعْتَصَمْتِ (iʕtaṣamti) /iʕ.ta.sˤam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# اِعْتَصَمَتْ (iʕtaṣamat) /iʕ.ta.sˤa.mat/: third-p
